title: A Comparison of Skin Lesions' Diagnoses Between AI-Based Image Classification, an Expert Dermatologist, and a Non-Expert
summary: AI skin-lesion diagnoses were compared directly with clinician diagnoses in an evaluation study. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.

evidence.tested: AI skin-lesion diagnoses were compared directly with clinician diagnoses in an evaluation study.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
evidence.ai_role: AI skin-lesion diagnoses were compared directly with clinician diagnoses in an evaluation study.
